slides.texte_overlay:
how you build a magnetic
personality
Have strong interests and talk about them with joy. Whether it's old films or mountain biking, enthusiasm is the most attractive energy there is.
Be generous with praise. Notice what people do well and say it. Most people rarely hear a genuine compliment, so they remember who gave one.
Show up consistently. Same warmth on good days and bad days. People feel safe around someone whose mood doesn't swing every hour. Be that person for others.
Keep a sense of adventure. Suggest new places, new plans, new experiences. People are drawn to someone who makes life feel bigger.
Try this for 30 days: five minutes a day of history, art or science. Knowing surprising things makes you someone people want to talk to.
slides.texte_sophia: Try this for 30 days: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Knowing surprising things makes you someone people want to talk to.

slides.texte_overlay: Stay humble about your wins. Let others discover them. Confidence without bragging is one of the most magnetic combinations. Let your actions speak for you.
Be fully present. Look at people, listen, react. In a distracted world, full attention feels like a gift. Put the phone away and really listen to the person in front of you.
